name: BIT PDF/UA-Korrektur
description: BIT PDF/UA-Korrektur for SAC: makes PDF files accessible (PDF/UA-1) and checks them in three steps (upload, review, download), in German, French and Italian. Runs entirely in the browser, no file leaves the computer.

appTitle.description: Tool name in the top bar (left at the default, it follows the interface language)

appTagline.description: Line below the heading of step 1 (left at the default, it follows the interface language)
appTagline.default: Macht PDF-Dateien automatisch barrierefrei (PDF/UA-1). Alles läuft lokal in Ihrem Browser – keine Datei verlässt Ihren Computer.

logoText.description: Text in the logo square of the top bar

uiLanguage.description: Default interface language: de | fr | it. Users can switch; their choice is remembered if rememberSettings is on.

showLanguageSwitch.description: Show the DE/FR/IT switch in the top bar

showHeader.description: Show logo and tool name in the top bar

showSettings.description: Show the settings button and the settings summary. When hidden, the story defaults always apply.

showLibrary.description: Show the saved alternative texts in the settings drawer

showFooter.description: Show "Über dieses Werkzeug" (what is corrected automatically) in the settings drawer

colorScheme.description: Color scheme: light | dark | auto (follows the operating system)

accentColor.description: Accent color (hex) for the light scheme; light colors are darkened to keep AA contrast

fontFamily.default: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

contentMaxWidth.description: Maximum width of the content in px (0 = full widget width)

defaultLang.description: Default document language: de-CH | fr-CH | it-CH | rm-CH | en | de-DE | de-AT | fr-FR | it-IT | auto

defaultTitleMode.description: Default document title: keep (existing title, else from content) | content (main heading) | filename

defaultSuffix.description: Suffix added to the file name of corrected PDFs

defaultExisting.description: Already tagged PDFs: auto (keep good tags, recreate faulty ones) | retag (always recreate) | keep (always keep, only repair)

defaultBookmarks.description: Create bookmarks from headings when none exist

defaultAutostart.description: Process files immediately after adding them

rememberSettings.description: Remember settings changed by the user in this browser (local storage)

getFileCount.description: Number of files in the list

getDoneCount.description: Number of files that were processed successfully

getPassedCount.description: Number of processed files that passed the automatic PDF/UA check

getSummary.description: JSON array with one object per file: file, output, status (ready|queued|running|done|error), verdict (ok|hints|error), pages, rulesBefore, rulesAfter, passed, title, lang, altTextsToReview, messages

getLastResult.description: JSON object (fields as in getSummary) for the file processed last, or an empty string

getLastProcessedFile.description: Name of the file processed last, or an empty string

startAll.description: Correct all files that are ready (like the button "Korrigieren")

rerunAll.description: Process all finished files again (ignored while files are being processed)

clearAll.description: Remove all files from the list (except a file being processed)

downloadAll.description: Download all corrected PDFs as a ZIP file

downloadCsv.description: Download the overview of all files as CSV

openFilePicker.description: Open the file dialog to add PDF files (call it from a click handler, e.g. a button's onClick)

openFolderPicker.description: Open the folder dialog to add all PDF files of a folder (call it from a click handler)

getSetting.description: Get the current value of a setting by key: lang, title, logoAlt, imgAlt, chartAlt, suffix, existing, bookmarks, running, autostart (booleans as 'true'/'false')

setSetting.description: Set a setting by key (see getSetting) for the current user, e.g. setSetting('lang', 'fr-CH')

resetSettings.description: Restore the default settings of the widget

getEngineMode.description: Where PDFs are processed: 'worker' (Web Worker), 'inline' (main thread, e.g. when the Content Security Policy blocks blob: workers) or 'idle' (nothing processed yet)

getText.description: Get a configurable text by key: appTitle, appTagline, logoText

setText.description: Set a configurable text by key (appTitle, appTagline, logoText)

setVisibility.description: Show or hide a part of the widget: showHeader, showSettings, showLibrary, showFooter, showLanguageSwitch

getUiLanguage.description: Current interface language: de, fr or it

setUiLanguage.description: Switch the interface language: de, fr or it

goToStep.description: Show a step (1, 2 or 3) if it is available

onFilesAdded.description: Fired when PDF files were added to the list.

onFileProcessed.description: Fired when a file has been processed (successfully or with an error). Use getLastResult() for details.

onQueueFinished.description: Fired when all queued files have been processed.

onStepChanged.description: Fired when another step is shown. Use getStep() to read it.
